body:
Freeze the Savvy Cart AI product vision and the MVP acceptance criteria so later tickets can decompose and build a Google Cloud prototype before 18 Oct 2026.

Context:
- Google Cloud AI Builder Cup, JAPAC. Prototype deadline 18 Oct 2026. Submit before the end of that day, Asia/Colombo, with a three-hour buffer (portal hour unconfirmed).
- Theme locked: Retail & Commerce — Intelligent Customer and Business Experiences.
- Mission: an AI-assisted shopping experience that helps a household make a smarter one-store grocery decision. Google Cloud first (Cloud Run, Gemini, one ADK agent, Secret Manager). Honest AI: never invent prices, inventory, or discounts.
- Team problem (portal text was not pasted; a paste replaces it): the useful price is the one-store basket total after the offer's day, category, exclusions, minimum bill, cap, cannot-combine rule, and end date.
- Persona: fictional Karuppan, Colombo, Saturday shop, usual store Keells, Commercial Bank credit as an issuer and product name only, budget about LKR 12,000.
- Buying pattern is a static staple fixture with running_low flags. Those flags only pre-check rows. Budget is displayed and does not change the discount or the winner. It is not a trained forecast.
- Both sample offers are Keells: Saturday and Thursday. Cargills and SPAR have fictional shelf prices and no offer. The day comparison reuses one shelf snapshot and shows the legal LKR saving on each of those days, plus valid_to.
- One fixture substitution starts applied. Reject swap restores the original SKU. The engine invents no other substitutes.
- Use sample receipt shows fixtures/receipt-expected.json. Extract this image calls Gemini. A failed live extract leaves the sample lines on screen.
- Explain and approve recompute the plan on the server. A client-supplied discount is ignored.
- Prices are fictional and labeled. Offer rows copy public term patterns and are not a live bank promotion.
- This ticket touches specs and docs only. Do not create application source, fixtures code, or a Cloud Run service.

Deliverables:
- specs/000-hackathon-context/context.md records the locked theme, Karuppan, and assumptions A1–A10.
- specs/001-product-vision/spec.md records the problem, persona, MVP path, GCP list, and out-of-scope list.
- .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md is the executable contract: guest Cloud Run path, Gemini receipt extraction, deterministic optimizer, two offer-days, expired-offer zero, explanation bound to JSON, mock approve, and the pytest commands.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Karuppan and Retail & Commerce are recorded in the vision, the hackathon context, and the executable spec. Verify: rg -n "Karuppan" specs/001-product-vision/spec.md specs/000-hackathon-context/context.md .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md (a match in each file) and rg -n "Retail & Commerce" specs/000-hackathon-context/context.md.
2. The executable spec names a verification command on every MVP acceptance criterion. Verify: rg -c "Verified by" .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md prints 11.
3. spec-lint reports no vacuous acceptance criteria on the executable spec. Verify: adlc spec-lint .adlc/specs/SC-001-product-vision.md exits 0.
4. This ticket adds no application tree. Verify: git diff --name-only against the base commit matches only specs/**, .adlc/specs/**, docs/**, and README.md.
title: Freeze product vision and MVP acceptance criteria
